reason: The finiteness argument uses a false hidden finite-dimensionality assumption. The allowed def-hcb-datum requires only an extended epsilon-C*-algebra, whose registered definition is a complete self-adjoint operator space and does not require finite dimension. Concretely, at e=0 take A=B(l2), P=R=S=I, and Q a rank-one projection; this is an allowed datum with one-dimensional Q, but M_n tensor S_P=M_n tensor B(l2) is infinite-dimensional. Hence linearity does not imply that h_n is bounded or that b_n=||h_n|| is finite. def-ha-map only puts each pointwise value h_n(Z) in a bounded-operator algebra; it does not supply boundedness of the map Z -> h_n(Z). A permitted estimate proving this boundedness (or an explicit finite-dimensional hypothesis) is missing, so the subsequent operator-norm argument is not justified for every datum in the contract.
